They have distributed and produced many films for the UK such as "Bend It Like Beckham", "What's Cooking? ", "Cabin Fever", "Jeepers Creepers" and "It's All Gone Pete Tong".  The first theatrical film released by Redbus was "Open Your Eyes".  Redbus's film releases were formerly distributed on home video by Warner Home Video.
Victor Salva | Victor Ronald Salva (born March 29, 1958) is an American film director and screenwriter.  He directed the films "Powder" (1995) and "Jeepers Creepers" (2001).  The latter of these has been expanded into a franchise with two sequels that he has also directed.
